sharedFacts.buildPattern: Working pattern scripts/build-census-v1-va_exp_identity_used_by_another-set.mjs (maps-with-canonical-and-boundary field maps, composed pleadings, byte proof read back from saved packet bytes), adapted for zero bound sources; each script self-contained per its row's exclusiveScript (no shared host created; b6's in-progress GA host untouched).
sharedFacts.overlayDiscipline: Only held participant identity/contact facts are written (name, DOB, address, phone, email — and only where the page prints them). Every case fact is a labelled dotted blank declared REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with a printed label, disclosed in participant-instructions.md, with a named checkable authority (court office, DMV, probation office, DESPP-SPBI, GCIC, ISP, SBI, circuit clerk, facility, agency). No signature, notary/jurat, judicial, prosecutor-approval, clerk or court-date field is ever written; nothing invented; unresolved legal questions preserved as unresolved and routed to approval-request.json.
sharedFacts.determinism: stampDeterministic() on every PDFDocument.create(); save with useObjectStreams:false, updateMetadata:false. Each family built at least twice (once --no-raster, once with raster); canonical and boundary packet SHA-256s byte-identical across runs for all eight.
sharedFacts.raster: Local Chromium calibrated raster (scripts/raster/pdf-page-raster.mjs) rendered every page of every fixture; recorded as RASTER_LOCAL_PENDING_CENTRAL — never a gate result. rendered-artifacts.json declares canonical+boundary fixtures in the v1 pdfs shape (file, documentId, fixture, sha256).
sharedFacts.verifier: node scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/verify-packet-completeness.mjs --family <id> -> PASS_COMPLETE with all nine counters zero, for all eight (lean rule: per-family verifier only; no full repo suite).
sharedFacts.nothingCommercial: commercialRoutesOpened 0 everywhere; every family ends at state_built with reviewStatus qa_review_pending; approval-request.json carries the counsel questions.
